expectations.text: Recommends moving checks down to faster unit or integration tests
expectations.evidence: Move logic to unit and server behavior to integration, target 70/20-25/5-10

expectations.text: Keeps only a few end-to-end journeys and names which ones
expectations.evidence: Names sign in, create a care task, share with family member, delete data

expectations.text: Treats flaky tests as bugs to be diagnosed
expectations.evidence: Only 'Quarantine flaky tests and fix or delete them. Do not rerun blindly'; no diagnosis of causes or framing as bugs

expectations.text: Does not tell the user to adopt a new test framework without asking
